metadata.desc: Your attentive schedule keeper, with morning broadcasts, habit reminders, LLM-driven schedule management, two-way Apple Calendar sync, and Notion to-do sync.

basic_settings.hint: Broadcast persona, form of address, and recipient users.

persona_id.hint: The persona used for morning broadcasts and habit reminders. Leave blank to take it from the session automatically.

user_nickname.hint: How the user is addressed in broadcasts. Leave blank to use 'Master'.

user_ids.hint: One per line: the user IDs that receive automatic reminders (QQ number or platform UID, UMO format supported).

schedule_reminder_settings.hint: Smart reminder toggle, lead time, and scan frequency for schedules.

enable_schedule_reminder.hint: When enabled, the AI generates a natural-language reminder as a schedule item approaches, using the conversation context.

schedule_reminder_minutes.hint: How many minutes before a schedule item starts to remind. All-day events do not get a reminder.

schedule_reminder_check_interval.hint: Scan frequency; 1/3 to 1/2 of the lead time is recommended (e.g. 3-5 when the lead time is 10 minutes). Minimum 2 minutes, and no greater than the lead time.

habit_reminder_settings.hint: Scheduled reminders for morning greeting, bathing, sleep, drinking water, and more.

enable_morning_report.hint: Pushes a morning broadcast at a fixed time every day, including weather, today's schedule, and Notion to-dos.

enable_bath_reminder.hint: Reminds about bathing at a fixed time every day.

enable_sleep_reminder.hint: Reminds about going to sleep at a fixed time every day.

enable_water_reminder.hint: Reminds about drinking water at intervals within the configured time range.

water_start_time.hint: Format HH:MM; no reminders before this time.

water_end_time.hint: Format HH:MM; no reminders after this time.

calendar_sync_settings.hint: Sync settings for Apple Calendar and WebCal calendars.

enable_apple_calendar_sync.hint: Syncs iCloud calendar events locally, with both read and write support.

apple_calendar.hint: iCloud login credentials and target calendar.

username.hint: e.g. xxx@icloud.com; two-factor authentication must be enabled.

app_password.hint: Not your login password! Go to appleid.apple.com → Security → Generate an app-specific password.

calendar_id.hint: Only a calendar UUID is supported; leave blank to default to the first calendar. The UUID can be copied from the CalDAV server address of Apple Calendar: the address looks like …/calendars/<UUID>/ — take the UUID segment and fill it in.

external_services_settings.hint: API credentials for Notion and the weather service.

maton_api_key.hint: Used for Notion to-do sync; sign up at https://www.maton.ai to obtain it.

notion_db_ids.hint: One per line; an optional type prefix may be used, e.g. 事务:xxxxxxxx or 阅读:yyyyyyyy.

weather_api_key.hint: Weather data for the morning broadcast; obtain it from https://seniverse.com (the free tier is sufficient).

weather_city.hint: Enter a city name, e.g. Beijing, Hangzhou, Shanghai.

message_render_settings.hint: How reminder and broadcast messages are rendered as Markdown.

markdown_enabled.hint: When enabled, the platform decides automatically: native platforms receive raw md text, others fall back to plain text.

markdown_native_platforms.description: Additional platform type names with native Markdown support
markdown_native_platforms.hint: One platform type name per line (e.g. qq_official, discord); entering an instance ID has no effect. Common platforms are built in by default.

qq_markdown_enabled.description: Native Markdown on QQ Official platform
qq_markdown_enabled.hint: On = QQ sends native md directly (tables included); Off = QQ is forced to plain text. If this item is not configured, it follows the global markdown_enabled switch.

prompt_settings.hint: LLM prompt templates for each reminder. Leave blank to use the built-in default; fill them in to customize the reminder tone. {placeholder} variables are supported.
